extraction_method: JSON data artifacts fetched verbatim (no DOM scraping). Opened own chrome-devtools page on https://deepswe.datacurve.ai/ inside an isolated browser context (isolatedContext=deepswe-rescrape-20260904, per a mid-task coordinator instruction to rename the context; the page's numeric id churned repeatedly under heavy contention from 9 other agents sharing the same browser -- final stable id was 17). Selected the page and verified location.href before every evaluate_script call; a same-turn select_page + evaluate_script pairing (both tool calls issued together) was needed to close the race window, since single-call select-then-verify-then-fetch sequences lost the race to other agents' concurrent select_page calls roughly 35 times in a row before that fix worked. Used the page's own same-origin fetch() to pull the 4 known artifact URLs plus 8 candidate probe paths, saved via evaluate_script's filePath option. No Node/curl fallback was used.

notes: AGENT/SCAFFOLD: every row on this site was run with the 'mini-swe-agent' harness. Kept as its own 'agent' field, never merged into the model name. Unchanged from 2026-09-03.

COST ADJUSTMENT: raw.json holds the untouched artifacts, whose mean_cost_usd is priced at the model's ORIGINAL API rates. The site re-prices 7 specific models client-side (glm-5-3-flash, gpt-5-6-luna, gpt-5-6-terra, gpt-5-6-sol, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash, gemini-3-6-flash); normalized.json carries those adjusted values forward unchanged from 2026-09-03 raw data (those 65 pre-existing configs are byte-identical to yesterday). The new gpt-6-astra model is NOT in the re-pricing list, so its cost_usd in normalized.json is the raw, unadjusted mean_cost_usd verbatim.

MODEL NAMES: display names reproduce the site's slug->display transform inferred from the 2026-09-03 dataset's slug/display pairs (join two adjacent tokens with '.' when the second token is purely numeric and the first ends in a digit, else join with '-'; strip a trailing '-preview'). Applied to the new model: raw slug 'gpt-6-astra' -> display 'gpt-6-astra' (no dot insertion needed, single digit token). Not independently re-verified against the rendered page's JS bundle today.

PROVIDER: new gpt-6-astra rows carry an explicit 'provider': 'openai' field directly in the raw artifact (a field absent from all pre-existing rows, which have no provider field in raw and had provider derived from the site's JS bundle on 2026-09-02/03). Mapped to 'OpenAI' for Title-Case consistency with the rest of normalized.json. All other 65 configs' provider values are unchanged from 2026-09-03 (not re-derived, since their raw rows are byte-identical).

Ranks for 'DeepSWE v1' and 'DeepSWE v1 (curated selection)' are unchanged (no new rows in those artifacts) and were carried forward verbatim from 2026-09-03.
METRICS: unchanged definitions from 2026-09-03 (pass@1 = attempt pass rate over scored rollout attempts; pass@4 = tasks with >=1 passing rollout / tasks attempted).
context_window: OMITTED, same as 2026-09-03 (median_peak_context_tokens carried under its own name instead; null for gpt-6-astra rows since the source field is null for that model).

EXTRA FIELDS beyond the requested shape, all straight from the source: reasoning_effort, config, n_tasks_attempted, n_runs, mean_output_tokens, mean_agent_steps, median_peak_context_tokens, ci_half_pct.

MODEL CHECK: 'muse-spark-1.3' / 'Muse Spark 1.3' is STILL NOT present on this leaderboard as of this scrape. Only muse-spark-1.2 and muse-spark-1.1 exist in the data. Verified absent by scanning all 230 normalized records' model field.

BROWSER CONTENTION: this scrape ran concurrently with 9 other agents sharing one browser instance. select_page->evaluate_script as two separate tool calls lost the shared 'selected page' race to other agents' calls dozens of times in a row before switching to issuing both calls together in the same turn, which worked on the first try. Anyone re-running this pattern under similar contention should expect the same and plan for many retries or the same-turn batching workaround.

changes_vs_20260903.summary: A new model, gpt-6-astra (OpenAI), was added to the DeepSWE v1.1 leaderboard with all 5 reasoning-effort configs (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) -- 65 configs/27 models on 2026-09-03 became 70 configs/28 models today. A previously-unfetched artifact, v1.1/tasks.json (per-task metadata, 113 rows), was discovered and added to raw.json but is not part of the normalized model/benchmark/metric schema.
